item.title: Fraud reports in the Netherlands jump 60% to over 100,000 cases
item.description: The Netherlands saw a sharp rise in fraud reports last year, with cases often beginning online and ending in real-world losses, authorities said.

item.title: Police clear protest against asylum center in The Hague’s Vogelwijk
item.description: Police used charges and batons Saturday during a demonstration against the planned arrival of asylum seekers at a former hospital in the Vogelwijk neighborhood.

item.title: Two KLM jets collide at Schiphol
item.description: Two KLM aircraft collided Saturday morning at Schiphol Airport, authorities and the airline confirmed. All passengers and crew on both planes were unharmed.

item.title: Netherlands sets Winter Olympics gold record as Bergsma and Groenewoud win in Milan
item.description: The Netherlands won another two gold medals on Saturday afternoon at the Winter Olympics in Milan.

item.title: Ajax and NEC share points in tense 1-1 draw at Johan Cruijff Arena
item.description: Ajax and NEC played to a 1-1 draw at the Johan Cruijff Arena on Saturday. This result puts both clubs at risk of falling further behind Feyenoord.

item.title: Driver and passenger under influence flee after hitting 74-year-old cyclist
item.description: A 40-year-old woman hit a 74-year-old cyclist Friday afternoon on the Emopad while driving under the influence of multiple drugs.
